description: This file contains utility functions for parsing Swagger/OpenAPI JSON specifications, normalizing URLs, parsing test case rows, and executing API test cases based on data read from an Excel sheet. It defines a data class EndpointSpec to represent API endpoints and provides functions to generate endpoint mappings, execute test cases, and handle HTTP requests accordingly.

classes.name: EndpointSpec
classes.description: Data class representing a discovered API endpoint with method, path, and optional content types and base URL.

methods.name: Dict[str,EndpointSpec] parse_swagger_json(swagger_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Parses a Swagger/OpenAPI JSON bytes object and returns a mapping of operation IDs or method+path to EndpointSpec objects.

methods.name: str _normalize_url(base_url: str, path: str)
methods.description: Normalizes and combines a base URL and a path into a complete URL string.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,Dict[str,Any]] _parse_row_dict(row_values: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of row values from the test case Excel sheet to extract operation ID, base URL override, method, path, payload, and expected status.

methods.name: Tuple[bytes,int,int,int] execute_testcases(swagger_bytes: bytes, testcase_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Executes specified test cases from an Excel file against endpoints defined in a Swagger JSON, and returns the modified Excel bytes along with test statistics.

ctags.name: _parse_row_dict
ctags.pattern: /^def _parse_row_dict(row_values: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[str, str, Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: execute_testcases
ctags.pattern: /^def execute_testcases(swagger_bytes: bytes, testcase_bytes: bytes) -> Tuple[bytes, int, int, int/
